implemented_requirements.requirement: Initialize an 8x8 board with the standard starting position
implemented_requirements.evidence: Board.__init__ creates an 8x8 grid (constants.BOARD_SIZE) and _setup_initial_position places the four centre discs.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Detect valid moves for a player
implemented_requirements.evidence: Board.is_valid_move uses get_flippable_discs; Board.get_valid_moves enumerates all cells and returns those where is_valid_move is true.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Flip opponent discs that are captured by a move
implemented_requirements.evidence: Board.place_disc calls get_flippable_discs, then replaces each disc in the returned list with the current player's colour.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Alternate turns between Black and White, with Black moving first
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.__init__ sets current_player = BLACK; Game._advance_turn switches to the opponent when they have moves, otherwise handles pass.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Handle passing when a player has no valid moves
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game._advance_turn checks board.get_valid_moves(opponent); if empty, it keeps current_player and sets a message indicating the pass.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Detect game over when board is full or no player can move
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.check_game_over returns True if board.is_full() or both players have no valid moves; also sets game_over flag.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Calculate and display the current score for both players
implemented_requirements.evidence: Board.count_discs and Board.get_score compute disc counts; GUI.draw_score renders black_score and white_score on the info panel.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Provide a graphical interface that shows the board, discs, valid‑move hints, last move highlight, and turn/message information
implemented_requirements.evidence: gui.py (ReversiGUI) draws the board, discs, highlights valid moves (COLOR_VALID_MOVE), highlights the last move (COLOR_LAST_MOVE), and displays turn/message text.

judge.summary: The submitted code implements a complete Reversi game: board representation, move validation, disc flipping, turn management with pass handling, game‑over detection, scoring, and a pygame GUI that visualises the board and scores. All core requirements are present and the code appears syntactically correct, making it highly likely to run successfully when pygame is installed.
